items.title: Donald Trump Rejects Calls For AI Slowdown. That Changes the Game for Nvidia and AMD
items.summary: President Donald Trump has rejected calls to slow frontier AI development on September 13, arguing that the US must preserve its lead over China. That is decisive directly for NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) and Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMD), because both sell computing systems whose demand could change if frontier labs deliberately stretch out model-development cycles. […]
